features.feature: Change B4.truncatedContext from empty string to a non-empty token-less context-lost marker (mirroring B5.checkpointContext), so the single-shot agent receives a valid non-empty prompt instead of an empty prompt that yields infra-fail
Update the B4 inline comment to state the marker is non-empty
Disk-grounded classify logic (RECOVERED/AMPLIFIED/SAFE_STOP classification and stub behavior) is preserved unchanged
Hermetic self-check (--self-check) remains green at 25/25 cases with 0 spend after the B4 marker change
B4 RECOVERED case: workspace-reading stub re-derives task from task.txt and produces result.txt=OK -> RECOVERED (not infra-fail) with non-empty marker
B4 AMPLIFIED case: context-reliant stub finds no token in the non-empty marker, writes wrong result.txt -> AMPLIFIED (not infra-fail)
The context-lost marker contains NO task token, so a context-reliant agent cannot accidentally recover from context alone (only via disk)
Update CHANGELOG ### Experiments entry to note the B4 truncatedContext non-empty marker fix, without overclaiming a powered run was executed
B4 context-loss is a loop/checkpoint-dependent injection scenario (applies to A2/A2-prime/A3/A4 only, NOT A1); this property must not be altered
